resources.string: Replace this saved appearance with the current one? The other slots will not change.
Delete this saved appearance? Your current profile appearance will not change.
Could not save or apply this appearance. Check that its media is still available and your device has free storage.

Save your own appearance in an empty slot before installing a workshop profile. Then save the workshop appearance in another slot. Tap a saved slot to switch; hold it to replace or clear it. These three slots belong to this account and stay on this device. Workshop installs and profile resets do not erase them. Provider connections and credentials are not saved or restored.
